Annual Plant

Origin : Europe
Environment : open land, in full sun; on rich and humid soils

Notes :
This Brassica species grows better in cooler climates. For this reason, it is often seeded in Autumn or at the beginning of the Winter, for a late Winter/early Spring crop. They require sun and a deep, rich, constantly humid but well drained soil. The Cabbage is very popular in Central and Northern Europe, and especially in Germany, where it is part of the traditional kitchen. The young plants are much appreciated by the snails, who are a threat to the cultivations. The Cabbage is rich in fibres, minerals, and C vitamin, and protects the stomach from bacterial infections.

description_text: Designed to create a spinning light displayaround room walls, this unit sits above most any incandescentlamp by way of a vertical center rod (supplied by user) that isfastened atop a lamp shade support. The lightfilter rotates as the rising heat from the light bulb passes upthrough its fan blades.  Lamp light shining up through the manyholes in the unit is scattered into a spinning array of light shapesthat dance across surrounding walls. Color canbe added to the light if transparent color film is added around theinterior circumference.  Tabs inside the circumference of the cylinder aredesigned to hold a 2" x 14.63" long ribbon of transparent color film,or lenses, for a variety of effects.  The model is designed tofit within a 5.5" cube of space to accommodate small 3-D printers. Of course, a printed model must be suspended at a sufficient distance from thebulb so that heat does not deform the thermo-plastic; user will have toexperiment for the optimum distance with the bulb wattage used.  A light gage coat hanger wire with a sharpenedtip is suggested for the central support rod.

description_text:
Premium, production-ready 3D model set featuring a modern lounge armchair and matching pouf (ottoman). This asset is officially Verified by CGTrader, passing all strict technical and visual checks to ensure an error-free, professional workflow for high-end architectural visualization (ArchViz) and interior design projects.
With a highly optimized mesh of ~180k polygons, this elegant seating set perfectly balances lightweight scene performance with hyper-realistic cloth/leather drapery, wrinkles, and cushion details. It serves as an ideal accent piece for contemporary living rooms, hotel lobbies, master bedrooms, executive offices, and luxury lounge spaces.
CGTRADER VERIFIED TECHNICAL FEATURES:

  - Certified FBX Workflow: Fully validated binary FBX file for faster loading times and performance.

  - Industry-Standard PBR Textures: High-resolution physically-based rendering maps included (Base Color, Roughness, Metalness, and Normal Map).

  - Clean Geometry: 100% clean polygon mesh consisting of triangles/quads with No N-gons and No faceted surfaces.

  - Flawless UV Mapping: Professionally UV-unwrapped model layout with No UV overlaps.

  - Texture Optimization: Standard square texture aspect ratios with Power of 2 sizes to maximize rendering efficiency.

Technical Specifications:

  - Polygons: 180,349

  - Vertices: 180,611

  - Real-World Scale: Yes, modeled to accurate dimensions using the Millimeters (mm) system units.

  - Grid Position: Perfectly centered at the origin coordinates system (0,0,0).

  - Clean Asset Structure: Texture paths are fully stripped. No cameras, studio lighting setups, or external third-party plugins are included in the asset file.

Available File Formats:

  - Native format: 3ds Max 2014 (with custom, photo-ready Corona Renderer materials and shaders applied).

  - Exchange formats: OBJ (Multi-Format, 2 files, 28.4 MB), FBX (Verified Autodesk FBX, 12.1 MB).

Cross-Platform Compatibility Note: While natively configured for 3ds Max and Corona Render, the inclusion of fully unwrapped UVs and standard PBR texture maps allows you to effortlessly import the verified FBX or OBJ formats into Blender (Cycles/Eevee), Cinema 4D, Maya, or Unreal Engine and set up identical realistic materials in seconds.
SAVE MONEY WITH THE COMPLETE PACK:This lounge chair and pouf set is an integral part of the Sofa and chair collection. Boost your design consistency and save budget by purchasing the complete 3-item furniture pack available at a discounted price in my profile gallery!
If you are satisfied with the model quality, please leave a positive feedback! Click on my username to explore my complete 3D asset gallery for more premium furniture pieces.

description_text:
This set includes four different Stainless Steel Cooking Pots with Glass Covers. Created with Blender 2.76 and rendered in Cycles.
|| GEOMETRY ||
Clean geometry, quads only. No ngons! Modifiers are not applied, so you still have full and easy geometry control.
Used modifiers:
  - subsurf - mirror - solidify
|| VERTEX COUNT ||
One pot has 5.876 Vertices and 5.900 Faces. All four pots have 23.504 Vertices and 23.600 Faces.
|| MATERIALS ||
3 Materials created with nodes for Cycles Render. Colors are changeable in the node setup.
  - chrome - stainless steel - glass
|| COMPOSITING ||
Compositing setup to render the model isolated from the environment with alpha values as background included.
|| RENDERS ||
  - renders created in Cycles Render at 10.000 samples using subsurf modifier level 2 - wireframe renders are showing the mesh without subsurf modifier
|| SCALE ||
The model is in real world size and scale.
Small Pot:
X = 0,252m (Blender units) Y = 0,176m (Blender units) Z = 0,169m (Blender units)
Medium Pot:
X = 0,293m (Blender units) Y = 0,217m (Blender units) Z = 0,189m (Blender units)
Flat Pot:
X = 0,293m (Blender units) Y = 0,217m (Blender units) Z = 0,137m (Blender units)
Big Pot:
X = 0,338m (Blender units) Y = 0,262m (Blender units) Z = 0,209m (Blender units)
|| EXPORTED FILES ||
This model was created with Blender. Only the blend file includes materials and modifiers. All other formats have been exported and are including only the mesh!

description_text:
This product only works with blender 2.8 because it uses their new eevee engine for realtime renders.
This studio can be used to create quick high quality renders of your products.the building can also be exported to other renderers/game engines
The car in the renders is included for free (name: SHC MCE 45)
every object and material you import into this studio will automaticly adapt the direct/indirect lighting and reflections.
For optimisation reasons the building is linked together by material (so every material is a single object)The included car is also linked into one object
The studio and area lights are separately linked.
The white background is ideal for product presentation, but the rest of the building space is also suited for renders.
by using this studio, it takes about 1 minute to generate a 1080P render on a GTX960 graphics card.
There are 3 presets of lighting in the product folder:

  - nighttime white studio lighting (use this one for the white background renders)

  - daytime ceiling lighting

  - daytime natural lighting only

If you decide to rebake the indirect lighting and reflectionprobes, it will take about 10 minutes on a GTX960 graphics card.
for any questions: feel free to contact me.

description_text:
Valmet Oy was a Finnish state-owned industrial conglomerate.
Valmet (originally Finnish: Valtion Metallitehtaat — English: State Metalworks) was formed in 1951, when the state of Finland decided to group their various factories working on war reparations to the Soviet Union under one company. Valmet and the factories fused with it produce a wide array of products including paper machines, board machines, aeroplanes, automobiles, Diesel engines, locomotives, trams, trolleybuses, weapons and everyday household appliances. Valmet merged with Rauma company in 1999, and the current Metso Corporation was created.

description_text:
Pininfarina S.p.A. is an Italian car design firm and coachbuilder in Cambiano, Italy.
Founded as Societa anonima Carrozzeria Pinin Farina in 1930 by automobile designer and builder Battista "Pinin" Farina, Pininfarina has been employed by a wide variety of high-end automobile manufacturers, including Ferrari, Maserati, Rolls-Royce, Cadillac, Jaguar, Volvo, Alfa Romeo, Honda, Fiat, Peugeot and Lancia. It also has designed trams in France and Greece, high-speed trains in Holland, and trolleys in the USA. Since the 1980s Pininfarina has been consulted on industrial and interior design.
The Pininfarina Group employs more than 3,000 people in subsidiary company offices throughout Europe, as well as in Morocco and China. Pininfarina is registered and publicly traded on the Borsa Italiana (Milan Stock Exchange).

description_text:
High-quality low-poly 3D model of U.S. Ambulance Vehicle.  The Interior part is also modeled and textured but with less detail.
It is best for use in games and other VR / AR, real-time applications such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
It can also be rendered in Blender (ex Cycles) or Vray as the model is equipped with detailed textures.
Model is built with great attention to detail and realistic proportions with the correct geometry,
this way it is also good enough for close-ups.
Technical details:

  - 2048 x 2048 Diffuse and AO textures

  - 5304 Triangles

  - 3117 Polygons

  - 3227 Vertices

  - Model is correctly divided into main part and wheels.

  - Model completely unwrapped.

  - Model is fully textured with all materials applied. 

  - Pivot points are correctly placed to suit animation process.

  - Model scaled to approximate real world size (centimeters).

  - All nodes, materials and textures are appropriately named.

Available file formats:

  - Blender files and example render scenes (Eevee studio setup and Cycles HDRI)

  - Blender files in 2 versions (packed and regular-unpacked)

  - Unity3D 2018.4 (.unitypackage)

  - Unreal Engine 4.27 (.uasset)

  - Maya 2018.3 (.mb)

  - 3ds Max 2018 (.max)

  - USDZ/glTF 2.0 (.gltf)

  - Autodesk FBX (.fbx)

  - 3D Studio (.3ds)

  - Collada (.dae)

  - OBJ (.obj)

Additional Info:

  - Please feel free to contact me if you need any further information about this 3d model.
I will try to write back as soon as possible and help you clear up any doubts. I can also send you some additional screenshots if you need.

  - Please also contact me if there are any problems after purchase. We will try to solve the problem together ;)

  - To avoid misunderstandings this model is not intended for 3D printing.
It uses some low/mid-poly modeling tricks and is optimized for real-time and gaming apps and is an open mesh.
It is also intended primarily for rendering using various rendering engines (as Blender Cycles or Vray).

  - If you like this model and would like to make it printable please contact me first.
I'll try to make the model printable but I'll let you know if it is at all possible and what the differences will be.

Великолепное резное зеркало может стать украшением для ванной комнаты или будуарного столика.Габаритные размеры: 31 x 13 x 1.5 sm 
The evolution of glass mirrors in the Middle Ages followed improvements in glassmaking technology. Glassmakers in France made flat glass plates by blowing glass bubbles, spinning them rapidly to flatten them, and cutting rectangles out of them. A better method, developed in Germany and perfected in Veniice by the 16th century, was to blow a cylinder of glass, cut off the ends, slice it along its length, and unroll it onto a flat hot plate.  Venetian glassmakers also adopted lead glass for mirrors, because of its crystal-clarity and its easier workability. By the 11th century, glass mirrors were being produced in Moorish Spain.

Andrea Pirlo born 19 May 1979 is an Italian professional football coach and former player who was most recently the head coach of Serie A club Juventus. Considered one of the best deep-lying playmakers ever, Pirlo was renowned for his vision, ball control, technique, creativity, passing, and free kick ability.
Pirlo began his club career in 1995 as an attacking midfielder with hometown club Brescia, winning the Serie B in 1997. He signed for Serie A club Inter Milan a year later, but limited game time and loans away from the club saw him transfer to cross-city rivals AC Milan in 2001. There, Pirlo matured into a world-class player, and he then won two Serie A titles, two UEFA Champions Leagues, two UEFA Super Cups, a FIFA Club World Cup, a Coppa Italia, and a Supercoppa Italiana. He departed for Juventus in 2011, where he won four consecutive Serie A titles, two Supercoppa Italiana titles, and another Coppa Italia. In 2015, Pirlo joined Major League Soccer (MLS) club New York City FC, where he played for two years before retiring in 2017.
At international level, Pirlo played 116 matches for the Italian national football team, which is the fifth-most of all time. He made his senior debut in 2002, and captained his nation to a bronze medal in the 2004 Olympics. Pirlo was instrumental in Italy's triumph at the 2006 FIFA World Cup, winning the Bronze Ball and being elected to the Team of the Tournament. He repeated similar success as he led Italy to the final of the 2012 UEFA European Championships. Pirlo also represented his country at the 2004 and 2008 UEFA European Championships, the 2010 and 2014 FIFA World Cups, and the 2009 and 2013 FIFA Confederations Cups.
Pirlo finished in the top four five times in the IFFHS World's Best Playmaker award between 2006 and 2015. He placed fourth for UEFA Best Player in Europe in 2011, and seventh in 2015. He was named Serie A Footballer of the Year three times and voted to the Serie A Team of the Year four times. Pirlo was elected to UEFA Team of the Year in 2012, the UEFA Champions League Squad of the Season in 2015, and was part of the FIFPro World XI in 2006. He also placed seventh for the 2007 FIFA World Player, finished in the top ten three times for the Ballon d'Or, and was named an MLS All-Star in 2016. In 2019, Pirlo was elected into the Italian Football Hall of Fame.
Following his retirement, Pirlo was appointed as head coach at Serie C club Juventus U23 on 30 July 2020. He took charge of the first team nine days later, and won the Coppa Italia and Supercoppa Italiana in his debut season, before being dismissed in 2021

description_text: A Gaiwan is a Chinese bowl used for steeping and drinking tea. It consists of a saucer,a bowl and a lid. While this vessel can be used for any tea, it is especially preferred for teas with delicate flavors and aromas (green tea, white tea) , Gongfu Tea, and teas that can be infused multiple time. description_text:
Master Bedroom Scene Collection that was made using Blender. The models used in this collection are from my Master Bedroom Asset Pack along with some new models to help create a scene that can be customized or just kept the way it is. It adds two window models, the scene bedroom body, and baseboards that go along the top and bottom of the wall.   - Includes 17 texture UVLayouts to show how the models have been unwrapped

  - Includes 12 different models as well as the scene body objects and a demo file

  - Each model has been manually unwrapped, with matching PBR textures to their UVMaps

  - Each model has been organized neatly in the zip archive and are labeled accordingly

  - Normal maps used for some models to increase detail

  - Some models use a diffuse texture with an alpha channel to allow glass parts of objects to become transparent

  - Models are exported in 4 file formats (FBX, OBJ, 3DS, DAE/Collada)

Included Texture Types:

  - AO, Diffuse, Roughness, Gloss, Metallic, Normal

Because different computers have different disks topology, it might be necessary to change the textures patches on the destination computer.
Thank you for buying SQUIR models

description_text:
Realistic and detailed model of bathroom furniture Sanwerk set SIERRA (wall hung).
Includes:

  - Wall hanging Cabinet-100 with wash basin Prince100 and tap KLUDI ZENTA 

  - Wall hanging Tall Cabinet (h 1900 mm)

  - Wall hanging Semi Tall Cabinet (h 850 mm)

  - Mirrir cabinet Everest-100

  - Glass Shelf

[FEATURES]

  - Created with 3ds Max 2015, VRay 3.20.03.

  - The model ready for render.

  - The model is accurate with the real world size and scale.

  - The model has a fully textured, detailed design that is suitable for close-up renders.

  - Units used: mm.

  - The mesh object is centered in the scene.

  - All archives include textures.

  - Models of the washbasin and the tap are made under smoothing (Turbosmooth is disabled).

[SPECIFICATIONS]
This model contains 17 separate objects (Polys: 137 336; Verts: 137 439):

  - Cabinet Sierra Air100 - 5 objects.Polys: 56 947Verts: 57 045

  - Tall_Cabinet Sierra - 4 objects.Polys: 42 471;  Verts: 42 545

  - SemiTall_Cabinet Sierra Air - 3 objects.Polys: 28 871;  Verts: 28 869

  - Mirror Cabinet EVEREST100 - 4 objects.Polys: 7 859;  Verts: 7 810

  - Shelf Glass SanwerkPolys: 1 188;  Verts: 1 170

For FBX:Blend materials «2 Chrome Metal LOGO» (2nd of MultiMat_3 - tap KLUDI ZENTA) and«Mirror&Light_Lens» (4nd of MultiMat_1 - Mirror Cabinet EVEREST)was amended in fbx file because it is not beign exported in fbx format.To achieve better realism level it is recomended to set up that materials as Blend. (Screenshots of proper setup can be found in the archive).

|| USAGE ||
This model is suitable for use in broadcast, advertising, design visualization, real-time, video game etc.

This model contains 1 separate object. This model contains 2590 polygons. This model contains Blender Cycles materials.

|| GENERAL ||
Model is built to real-world scale(the unit system is metric). No third-party renderer or plug-ins needed.
|| INSTRUCTIONS ||
Put the files and textures into the same folder and start rendering.
|| ADDITIONAL NOTES ||
Other file formats. May be needed to reassign textures and will not render like the preview images. -FBX -OBJ

description_text:
TRADITIONAL GANTRY® PULLDOWN FAUCET - HOOK SPOUTMODEL NO. 4400 
ANNAPOLIS COLD ONLY FILTRATION FAUCET - LEVER HANDLEMODEL NO. 1100C 
Get great tasting, cold filtered water on demand. The decorative Annapolis Cold Only Filtration Faucet gives cold purified water to quench that thirst and is compatible with reverse osmosis filtration systems. When combined with the Waterstone Multi-Stage Filtration System, these traditional faucets add the convenience of pure filtered water to any sink area. Traditional water dispenser has a hook spout with 4-7/8″ reach and single lever handle design. Part of the Annapolis Suite, these water purification faucets can be Suited to match your other kitchen faucets, accessories, and cabinet hardware in both style and finish. Lifetime functional warranty and Made in the USA. A elegant and vintage design, the Annapolis Cold Only Filtration Faucet, is a great alternative to municipal tap water. Available in 32 finishes.
An original piece of art right in your kitchen. Your friends will be raving when they see this amazing centerpiece of your kitchen. It is innovative in both design and functionality. The Waterstone Gantry Pulldown’s patented, tall design was modeled after the massive size and strength of Gantry cranes in U.S. harbors and shipyards. Gantry cranes do the heavy lifting when it comes to unloading cargo ships. The faucet’s pre-rinse spray arm is spring-loaded and has a range of motion to reach every corner of your sink. The elegant hook spout has a 10-3/4” reach can swivel spout can spin 360 degree. Sink clean up is made really easy. The ergonomic sprayer handle is fully insulated against heat and swivels easily in your hand. Squeeze the sprayer’s lever and water instantly diverts from spout to spray. A hot/cold ceramic disk valve cartridge helps save water and controls the flow to a maximum of 1.75 gpm. When installing, you have the option of mounting the handle in the front, on the right or on the left. The handle can also adjust up to 22.5 degrees, right or left, for clearance from backsplash. Resistant to reverse osmosis water. Each Gantry Pulldown Faucet can be “Suited.” Add accessories that match in both finish and style. Soap/lotion dispensers, air switches or dishwasher air gaps create a professional collection of faucet features for the sink area. All Waterstone faucets are covered by a lifetime functional warranty and proudly made in the USA. This traditional Gantry Pulldown’s vintage, elegant design will definitely get your friends talking.

description_text:
Esta Mezcladora de la familia Helvex ha sido modelada de acuerdo con las proporciones reales. Se ha trabajado a detalle cada parte poligonal para evitar algun problema de Render. Todos los materiales son PBR, incluido el material del muro que "viene de REGALO . Se anexa un archivo HDRI por si desean utilizarlo en su escena, se sabe que el modelo se utilizara en otra escena que es muy probable que contenga su propio HDRI, asì aùn consideramos que podria serles de utilidad el archivo. La escena está renderizada en EEVEE y cuenta con un escenario de producto. El producto ya viene suavizado (incluso en sus normales) y optimizado; listo para usar en alguna escena.
El paquete incluye una mezcladora, un perfume que tengo a la venta, un bote de shampoo y todo lo que se observa en la escena. Todo en uno...
NOTAS IMPORTANTES PARA ARCHIVOS FBX:
• Si algún material cuenta con alguna imagen de textura, al convertir el archivo a FBX se puede perder el link con esta, sin embargo esto es muy fácil de solucionar. Simplemente usa la textura que se deja en el paquete, colocala en el mapa de Base Color y listo. Debido a que las texturas están mapeadas, esta se aplicará automáticamente. • Al abrir un archivo FBX aparecerá un “Cubo” que representa un “Material de Volumen”, si el “Cubo” no te sirve puedes eliminarlo de tu escena y podrás ver el producto en sí. • Se dejan 3 carpetas de archivos FBX con la finalidad de tener mas control sobre lo que desees abrir. Si quieres la escena completa tendrás que abrir la carpeta que dice: “Scene_Master_Collection”, pero si solo deseas abrir el producto sin ninguna luz o cámara, entonces puedes optar por abrir la carpeta que se llama “Collection”. • ES IMPORTANTE que al momento de importar un archivo “FBX” selecciones la opción que dice; “Import Subdivision Surface”, de no hacerlo el programa entenderá que solo deseas abrir el archivo sin ningún modificador ocasionando que no veas el producto suavizado.

description_text:
I like making boxes.  It's as simple as that.  There's just something about designing ornate and intricate jewellery and gift boxes which I find really rewarding, and as I'm getting better at designing things the intricacy of the boxes just gets greater!
A while ago I made a jewellery box in the shape of a Treasure Chest and I wanted to update the design, but I could never get the lid to the point where I was happy with it.  Then I realised that rather than making a chest I could make a trunk and it all just came together (geeky design detail: this is also the first box where I've managed to make a functional 3D printed hinge I'm happy with).  The Treasure Trunk is now to the point where I'm happy to release it into the world!
The Trunk is made from various 3D printed panels, all held together with a rigid frame (also 3D printed of course).  By default the body is printed in brown and the framing is printed in bronze-gold, but if you'd like it printed in other colours then please have at it, I'll be happy to see the results!
You can order a Treasure Trunk, printed and assembled and even with a small laser-engraved plaque for extra personalising, in my Etsy store - www.etsy.com/uk/shop/enterprisexddesign

description_text:
High-quality, photorealistic 3D model of a Modern Console Table Set, featuring a contemporary wooden hallway sideboard fully decorated with premium interior props, including a modern table lamp, a minimalist picture frame / artwork, art books, and a realistic wooden jewelry storage box.
This premium furniture asset is production-ready and meticulously crafted for professional interior architectural visualization (ArchViz), luxury living room designs, cozy entrance hallways, bedroom interior layouts, hotel lobbies, and modern residential staging.
Originally created with 3ds Max 2014, this model features clean, professional-grade topology, correct scene organization, and flawless texture mapping. Built to an accurate 1:1 real-world scale (mm) and perfectly centered at the origin coordinates (0,0,0) for effortless drag-and-drop integration.
Key Features & Technical Specifications:

  - Optimization: 37,726 polygons / 38,242 vertices — highly memory-efficient, ideal for complex rendering scenes and heavy interior projects.

  - UV Mapping: Professionally unwrapped UVs, 100% manual layout with no overlaps.

  - Textures & Materials: High-resolution wood, glass, metal, and paper PBR texture maps included. Fully configured with high-fidelity Corona Render shaders.

  - Native Format: 3ds Max 2014 (configured with high-fidelity Corona Render shaders).

  - Universal Exchange Formats: OBJ (2 files) and FBX with completely stripped texture paths.

  - Clean Asset: No external third-party scripts or plugins required to open and render the scene.

Hope you like it! If you are satisfied with this 3D model, please leave a positive feedback. Thank you!

description_text:
Ya Hamada is a 14-year-old high school graduate, and robotics genius living in the futuristic city of San Fransokyo (a portmanteau of San Francisco and Tokyo, rendered in kanji as 奏京) who spends much of his free time gambling in robot fights. To redirect Hiro, his older brother Tadashi takes him to the research lab at the San Fransokyo Institute of Technology, where Hiro meets Tadashi's friends - Go Go, Wasabi, Honey Lemon, and Fred - Baymax, the inflatable healthcare robot that Tadashi created, and Professor Robert Callaghan, the head of the university's robotics program. Amazed, Hiro decides to apply to the university. To enroll, he signs up for the school's showcase and presents his project: microbots, swarms of tiny robots that can link together in any arrangement imaginable using a neurocranial transmitter. At the fair, Hiro declines an offer from Alistair Krei, CEO of Krei Tech, to market the microbots, and Callaghan accepts him into the school. As the Hamada family leaves to celebrate Hiro's success, a massive fire suddenly breaks out in the showcase hall and Tadashi rushes in to save Callaghan, the only person left inside. The building explodes moments later. 
Models ready for printing in STL format. Divided into parts for FMD printers or a single file for SLA printing.

description_text:
Skadi is the Norse giant goddess of winter, hunting, and skiing. Known as the snowshoe goddess, she rules over mountains, wildernesses, winter, revenge, knowledge, damage, justice, and independence. Passionate in her pursuits, especially in the pursuit of justice, Skadi is determined to live how she wants and not be told by the gods of Asgard.
Skadi lives in the highest part of the mountain where the snow never melts in her father’s grand hall, Thrymheim. Odin once described her home as the “ancient court” and described her as the shining bride of the Gods. Skadi, a giant, is the enemy of the gods of Asgard. Being a giant, she is associated with darkness, cold, and death, just like winter. However, Skadi is seen to be more benevolent than the rest of her giant kin.
However, Skadi becomes welcomed by the gods of Asgard when she marries one of them. Her father, the giant Thiazi, kidnapped the goddess Idun, the beautiful goddess of youth, and, therefore, the gods’ apples of immortality. Odin killed him for doing so and rescued Idun. However, Skadi was furious and determined to avenge the death of her father. She took her weapons and stormed the citadel of Asgard claiming for either revenge or compensation—she gave them the choice of a harmful or benign consequence. The gods, scared of the ferociousness of Skadi, decided they’d rather give her gold. Skadi didn’t want gold, since she was already rich from her father and grandfather’s pillaging. Odin then offered her a husband from among the Asgardian gods, giving her the status of goddess. She agreed, but Odin said she could only look at the gods’ feet to choose her husband. Skadi agreed, hoping that she’d pick handsome Baldur, whom she had a crush on, but she chose ugly Njord, the god of the sea, because he had the best feet.
Njord and Skadi’s marriage didn’t last long—only half a month. Njord couldn’t stand the cold and isolated mountains and Skadi couldn’t stand the brightness and noise of the coastline. So, they got a divorce. There are different myths as with whom Skadi ended up afterwards. Some say she got together with Ullr, the god of winter and archery. But, some say she married Odin and gave birth to many sons with him
Both supported and unsupported versions included.

The product consists of two items, a glass and a pitcher, each with a metal stand. Each model has been grouped and consists of two meshes: The metal stand and the glass item - this is also illustrated in the preview images from the included Maya scene.
The product contains UV’ed low poly base meshes (without the glass details – see the pictures) in .fbx, .obj and .mtl format and textures which can be applied to show the glass and metal detailing. The final product is shown in the pictures. Using a base mesh and texture combination makes the product optimal for games or other situations where high performance is needed. Note that the high resolution (detailed) meshes are NOT included in the product, you can get the detailed look using the textures included.
The glass consists of a total of 1992 faces (3796 tris) over the two meshes (glass and stand) which is a combination of triangles and quads in order to give the best possible look of the object. It has furthermore 3890 edges and 1902 vertices. The two meshes have each their own UV map for ease of use in game engines such as Unity.
The pitcher consists of a total of 3334 faces (6396 tris) over the two meshes (pitcher and stand) which is a combination of triangles and quads in order to give the best possible look. It has furthermore 6532 edges and 3196 vertices. The two meshes also have each their own UV map.
The meshes of both items are optimised for usage in games and other realtime applications, such as VR, XR etc.Both the pitcher and glass are modelled in two layers to simulate glass thickness and thereby achieve best possible glass effect. If this is not wanted, one can easily remove the faces inside the picher and almost half the number of polygons of the bottle. If needed, I can do this for you - please reach out.
The textures for the detailing are exported for both Unity, Unreal Engine and PBR in 4096x4096 resolution. Scale these down in resolution as needed. In the product the following texture sets for both items (glass and pitcher) can be found:

  - 
Unity: AlbedoTransparency, ambientOcclusion, height, metallicSmoothness and normal maps

  - 
Unreal Engine 4: BaseColor, normal and occlusionRoughnessMetallic maps

  - 
PBR Metallic Roughness: BaseColor, height, metallic, normal and roughness maps

  - 
PBR Specular Glossiness: Diffuse (only the glass material), height, and normal maps

If different colours of the glass and pitcher is wanted, you can easily edit these textures. Please note that the previews are rendered in Substance Painter with a glass material specific for Substance Painter. Therefore, the texture materials do not contain opacity information, and depending on your renderer of choice, the glass material may look a bit different. The Substance Painter rendering scene is NOT included in the product, nor the Zbrush scenes.
The previews above consist of:

  - A Substance Painter render of both the pitcher and the glass base meshes

  - Five Substance Painter renders of both the pitcher and the glass base meshes from front, back, both sides as well as a high-view perspective.

  - Four wireframe images each of both the pitcher and the glass base meshes from front, back and both sides, rendered in Zbrush.

  - Screenshots of the Maya scene included in the product, showing the two objects from the front, back, high perspective and top. Notice how the triangles make the edges of the glass and pitcher more round for a better look.

  - Furthermore an XRay of the Maya scene is provided to illustrate the glass thickness

  - Screenshots of the UV mapping for both the glass and pitcher

If you have any questions or issues with the model, please contact me and I will help you as soon as possible :)

description_text:
This Antique Fireplace model is low poly and includes the FREE animated 'Flaming Pear' shown in the demos. It's poly/vertices counts are P=3024, V=1514. 
A video clip demonstrating 'Flaming Pear' animation can be viewed on Youtube - http://youtu.be/nQvDHdQE2CA 
The Antique Fireplace model and logs are UV mapped in 2048 X 2048 pixels. Color, gloss, displacement and normal maps are provided. The log cradle model is finished in a near-black color and is not UV mapped.  The 'Flaming Pear'is video textured. A PNG image sequence with alpha channels and a GIF animation are provided, in the event that your software does not accept video texturing.
In pre-release testing, 3DS Max accepted video texturing with alpha channel of both FBX and DAE 'Flaming Pear' animation, but dropped deformers. In Maya, new material nodes must be created as either Movie or File type with image sequence. Maya and 3DS Max import AntiqueFireplace01.fbx with nmap, but do not import  AntiqueFireplace01.dae or fireplace02.obj with nmap. The AntiqueFireplace01.fbx imports into Unreal Engine 4 without problems and it is recommended to use the Particle Fire, rather than the included 'Flaming Pear' in Unreal Engine 4. However, the 'Flaming Pear' can be used with Movie media and texture coordinate nodes in a material.

description_text:
3D model of Microwave Oven with Grill.
MODEL

  - Model dimensions: LWH 51,0 x 40,1 x 30,5 cm (20.1 x 15.8 x 12.0 in).

  - Objects count - 22

  - Subdivision - Partial (some objects in 3ds Max scene has instanced turbosmooth modifier applied).

  - Grouping - YES

  - Model is polygonal. Consists mainly of quads and triangles. Small amount of N-gons were used where appropriate.

  - Polycount:

  - Without subdivision -

  - Polys - 253 330

  - Verts - 289 024

  - With level 2 subdivision -

  - Polys - 330 565

  - Verts - 326 884

MATERIALS

  - Materials are prepared for Corona and V-ray renderers.

  - Scanline and FBX files has only basic materials and will NOT render the same as in preview images.

  - OBJ file has no materials, but has UVW coordinates intact.

TEXTURES

  - Model has 6 high quality textures of up to 1024 x 1024 resolution.

  - Textures are saved in JPEG and PNG formats.

  - Textures are collected in one archive and are delivered in separate file.

SCENE

  - Model is scaled to proper real world dimensions. Scene units are in cm.

  - Objects, materials and textures has meaningful and matching names.

  - Transformations has been reset and model is placed at scene origin [0, 0, 0 XYZ].

  - Texture paths are set to relative. Just unzip texture archive into a folder where the model is located and your 3D app should pick up them automatically.

RIG

  - Microwave oven's door are rigged with convenient helper which allows easily and conveniently open and close the door. Door movement is restricted accordingly  to real world counterpart.

  - FBX file has simplyfied rig.

  - OBJ file is not rigged.

FILE FORMATS

  - 3ds Max - Corona

  - 3ds Max - Scanline

  - 3ds Max - Vray

  - FBX

  - OBJ

  - GLB

GENERAL

  - Modeled in 3ds max.

  - Preview images are rendered with Corona renderer. Images are straight from 3ds Max. No post processing appart from Corona renderer built in tonemapping tools, were applied.

  - Render scenes are not included.

Please contact me if you have questions or need assistance with the models.

Features:Real world scale in Blender (Metric Units, Scale 0.1),polygonal model,All Cycles materials are included,Object is grouped so u can link/append them to your scene easily,All objects and materials are named logically,Object is UV unwraped,Short readme.txt which explains a possibilty how to link the object to your scene
Model Data:Low poly verison (Subsurf 0,1): polygons: 3644, vertices: 3604,Mid poly version (Subsurf 1,2): polygons: 14536, vertices: 14538,High poly version (Subsurf 2,3): polygons: 58144, vertices: 58146,
File formats:.blend Blender 2.75a (official build).dae exported from Blender.fbx exported from Blender.obj exported form Blender
Note:The Presantation Scene (the Black Background) is not included. But there is a very simple standard light setup which allows you to get a quick render.
Enjoy my Model!! And do not forget to rate ;)

The top and bottom stacks of potato chips are separated, so you can hide or show them, depending on the material you want to use for the bowl (transparent or opaque).
It also include the different potato chips used in a separate file, so you can make your own arrangement.  
-The size is based on real world scale.
-This product was created in Maya 2014. Preview render made with V-ray 3.
-File Formats included: ma, mb, fbx, obj, max 2011, max 2012, max 2013, max 2014.  
-The main version (.ma and .mb files) comes with V-Ray, mental ray and standard materials. 
-Fbx, Obj and Max formats contain standard materials.
-Polygon count details: 216 each potato chip.

Those rather difficult conditions had an influence on a somewhat strange image of the house. The window openings are defined in a shape of stationary window shades which have solid stained glass. description_text:
This wall-mounted wooden cabinet was part of a large commission from the Royal Hotel in Naples for Gio Ponti to design the furniture and interiors. Drawer handles are carved out from the panels in Ponti's angular design language, balancing form and function.
From molteni.it: Giovanni “Gio” Ponti, (Milan, November 18, 1891 - Milan, September 16, 1979), is one of the Italian masters of architecture. He was also a designer and essayist and one of the most important of the twentieth century. Other than the great architectural works which carry his unmistakable signature, he created a vast amount of work in the furniture sector. This is demonstrated in his three Milanese houses which were fully furnished in thePontistyle. The houses in via Randaccio, 1925, Casa Laporte in via Brin, 1926 and the last in via Dezza, in 1957 is anexpressionof his home design ideas. Gio Ponti was an Italian promoter of industrial design and introduced the idea of interior furnishing ranges produced as being asophisticated,economic,democraticand modern. Molteni&C managed a reissuing project of furniture and furnishings designed by Gio Ponti for products for these private homes and limited editions. After a long journey of research, selection and study of prototypes, the collection was exhibited at the Salone del Mobile 2012. This was thanks to the cooperation and the exclusively signed agreement of the Ponti heirs and the artistic director of Cerri & Associati Studio.
Model is created in Rhino and rendered with V-Ray. Textures are included and the folder should be placed in the same directory as the model.

description_text:
Description:A pack containing 20 detailed PBR ready barrel, bucket and tub game assets. These models have hoops made of wood poles and closed by ligatures. This was common practice up to the early 20th century, before metal became cheap to produce.
Features:

  - Available in .blend, .fbx, .obj and .3ds formats. Single scene in blender, split in to individual components for all other formats.

  - Works natively in .blend. All other file formats will require additional work due to import/export limitations. This includes material re-creation, and possibly re-applying smoothing groups.

  - Game ready low poly models. Tested in Unity.

  - Blender file comes with PBR materials for Cycles.

  - Triangle/vertex counts in the 500-1500 range per model.

  - Texture maps for the barrel material are 1024x2048, for the tub material 1024x1024, and for the bucket material 512x512. This is to maintain a consistent texel density.

  - 3 barrels of different sizes, as well as two special medium sized barrels: A broken one, and an open one with a separate lid.

  - 6 tubs of different sizes and shapes

  - 5 buckets. Two all wood buckets, two with metal hoops and handles, and one small wooden bucket/ladle.

  - 2 stacks of wooden hoops, one of which is set up in a way that it can be hanged from a wall if needed. 1 loose wooden hoop.

description_text:
2020 XFROGPLANTS SPECIES CONTAIN:
3DS MAX 2019: ARNOLD, VRAY, REDSHIFT, CORONA, and FORESTPACK.
C4D R20+, FBX, OBJ, 3DS, MAYA, LIGHTWAVE, MODO, VUE, TERRAGEN, XFR
---- PLEASE NOTE: .XFR files are also included with all file
---- format zips, so you can edit them with Xfrog Software if
---- you wish.
Bjuvia (Bjuvia simplex)
Cycadale
Period: Permian to Triassic
Environment : open and sunny planes
Climate : warm and dry
Notes :
Bjuvia simplex is a cycadale with a simple leaf pattern that resembles that of Taeniopteris, an archaic tree fern. After the Carboniferous glaciation, with the Permian arid climate, Bjuvia and all archaic cycadales could find more room to live as the plants of humid environments had to give up more and more space. Finally in the late Triassic Bjuvia and other archaic cycadales had to disappear in favour of more complex cycadeoids such as Bennettitales.
Model 1 specs: adult age, 8 meters
Model 2 specs: medium age, 5 meters
Model 3 specs: young age, 3 meters

description_text:
Sofa and armchair set
Are you looking for models into your architectural vizualisation? This set will look awesome in your render and you don't have to spend any time preparing it as it is ready-to-render. It consists of one sofa, one armchair, a lamp, glass table and tea set.
Technical info
Everything was done using Blender and Cycles rendering engine.Sofa and armchair are with leather material, table is made of glass, tea set has procedural clay material and plate is wooden. Everything is sorted, properly named, in the real-world-scale.No Subdivision: 22 598 Verts., 22 862 Faces, 44 796 Tris.Subd. turned on (Used for renders): 363 247 Verts., 362 958 Faces, 725 788 Tris.
Sorting of models
Models are placed close to centerModels are true-to-scaleLogicaly namedModels are sorted into groups
Appending models
Open your own .blendGo to File > AppendGo into models/groupsSelect model/group you want to append
Materials
Materials are leather, glass, wood, clay metal.There are two kinds of leather, but they differ only in color which is determined using color ramp. Color texture is turned into black/white and using color ramp you may do in any color you want. There are difuse, normal and spec textures included. The specularity map is heavily modified in node editor, but all you care about is the color ramp.Metal material is just basic - mixed difuse and glossy.Wood is mixed difuse and glossy using pointiess and with normal map applied.Clay is made of two difuse shaders mixed using pointiness and with bump generated using noise texture.Properly named

All textures are path striped.
3ds Max 9.0 and all higher versions.
